versions.changelog:
- Added planning and reference documentation: PLAN.md, SPEC.md, TODO.md
- Removed default data files: data/weread-raw.json and data/weread-normalized.json
- No functional or workflow changes; updates focus on documentation and project organization.

Initial release of WeRead Reading Recommender.

- Local-first tool to export, normalize, and analyze WeRead (微信读书) reading data.
- Recommends books based on reading history and/or current learning goals.
- Checks for existing local cookie/environment sources before prompting user for setup.
- Data privacy-focused: uses local cookies only, never echoes cookies, and avoids remote storage.
- Provides structured recommendations with rationale and profile analysis, supporting both safe and exploratory picks.
